# Create Effect

Source: [4342](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4342); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Create Effect](../../api/actions/create-effect.md).

<a id="wiki-4342-n1"></a>

- Effects persist until destroyed and expose Last Created Entity; new effects stop appearing at capacity.

<a id="wiki-4342-n2"></a>

- Archive gives 128 active Create Effect effects or 256 with extension.

<a id="wiki-4342-n3"></a>
